scope: Additional native YOLOv5-S/ViT-B16 and corrected external DETR optimizer; fixed PennFudan/CIFAR-10 subsets, not COCO/ImageNet convergence
selection: Final epoch only; all five fixed seeds; no best-checkpoint or best-seed selection
reason: User added YOLO and ViT. Initial DETR uniform/batch-scaled learning rates caused catastrophic forgetting in BOTH versions; preserve those results and use official-style separate backbone LR and no batch scaling for this new predeclared paired recipe.

equivalence.method: paired Student t two one-sided tests (TOST)
equivalence.interpretation: Fixed-holdout mean over training seeds only, not exact identity or full-benchmark equivalence

yolov5s.provenance: Native UP YOLOv5-S SiLU, one foreground class, random initialization, 320px mosaic, batch64, EMA off, original SGD/cosine, evaluate each10epochs

vit_b16.provenance: Native UP ViT-B/16, all12blocks/width768, CIFAR10/64px token grid, random initialization, batch64, native dropout/AutoAugment/Cutmixup/label smoothing, AdamW7.5e-4/cosine

detr.provenance: Same pinned official DETR R50 adapter-v2 in both UP trees; AdamW1e-4/1e-5 backbone, no batch LR scaling, same data/architecture/losses/gradient clipping; NOT an upstream UP model
